segments.startsWith: The children came home to one o'clock dinner

When Bobbie had parted from the Doctor

It took some time to arrange
She got the Station Master to give the letter

The morning of the fifteenth
It was a very nice plan
And alas, that very afternoon
It was when Mother had gone to the gate
A week later Bobbie managed
They climbed the steep steps
